d:
An American citizen—who has also worked as a mercenary—was once arrested by India on charges of illegal entry and held in Tihar Jail, before eventually being released on bail and sent back to the United States. This American has now made a significant claim regarding his arrest: Matthew VanDyke has directly linked his detention to the friendship between India and Russia, as well as the ongoing war in Ukraine.
Production: Supriya
Video Editor: Satyam
